question: What being remains when all beings perish?
premises: that being is manifest and unmanifest
it does not perish when all beings perish
inference: an eternal being beyond manifest and unmanifest remains indestructible
uncertainties: vyaktāvyaktaḥ is read as compound not split
plain_english: Beyond that is another eternal being, manifest and unmanifest, which does not perish when all beings perish.
